correctness.rationale: The orbit-simplex identification and dihedral equality follow exactly from coefficients constant on undirected distance orbits. value.rationale: Determines a sharp natural connectivity-threshold transition for an infinite family of highly symmetric graph complexes. It computes complete fixed homotopy types, gives exact and unbounded arithmetic counts of isolated Hamiltonian orbit points, and yields positive-dimensional fixed spheres for all squarefree numbers with at least three prime factors, despite the ambient high-dimensional topology. The result is not a numerical microgain or arbitrary finite slice.
